# Pinned Python dependency constraints for WeasyPrint, generated by running
# `pip3 freeze` inside the built image. PyPI never removes published
# versions, so — unlike the apt package pins in the Dockerfile — pinning
# these here is safe: it will not break a future build when a mirror rotates
# old versions out.
#
# fontTools in particular is the library WeasyPrint uses to subset and embed
# fonts; an unpinned upgrade could silently change how invoice PDFs render.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint sh app -c 'pip3 freeze'
# and review the diff before committing.
brotli==1.2.0
cffi==2.1.1
cssselect2==0.10.1
fonttools==4.66.0
pillow==12.3.0
pycparser==3.0
pydyf==0.12.1
pyphen==0.18.1
tinycss2==1.5.1
tinyhtml5==2.1.0
weasyprint==70.0
webencodings==0.6.1
zopfli==0.4.3
